activity_summary: You ate the heel in the kitchen and let Tuesday be a count. Twelve men at seven, and the twenty shillings already gone into the timber. The ale is the cousin's. Your mother saw the grey at your temple and said she was not discussing it. Edmund stays for school, and Richard is the one who will be believed. You said you would be the dull one, and you said you would not take the orchard sheet to the barn.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Promised seven, and the dullness, and the sheet left behind.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted the twenty shillings as spent, and sent the promise out of the kitchen.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Fed him the heel, and refused the grey as a topic.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the children, named school for Edmund, and asked for the hall clear.
